outcome: Experiences with ABE (pain, lactation support, willingness to repeat)
Total milk volume expressed (prior to birth)
cohort: The study participants were 138 individuals with gestational or pregestational diabetes from three health care facilities who were trained in antenatal breast milk expression (ABE).
finding: Individuals with gestational or pregestational diabetes who expressed reservations about antenatal breast milk expression (ABE) experienced heightened pain, reported lesser lactation support, were less willing to repeat the process, and expressed significantly lower total milk volumes (median 7mL vs. 21mL) compared to those without reservations.
